  PROBLEM: `command_shape()` does not normalize ANSI-C quoted command text before shaping it, so attached credential flags can bypass flag parsing and raw text can leak into the pattern shape.
  WHY: ANSI-C quoted tokens may start with `$` rather than `-`, bypassing flag detection and potentially leaving credential text verbatim in the issue title.
